recalculation.notes: All 30 sample P-V observations and the invertible Dorogokupets-Oganov (2007) ruby scale are bundled. The explicit as-reported dataset reduction supports normalization of printed pressures through the same corrected R1 ratio and a conditional reference-isotherm refit (scripts/audit_kcl_pressure_normalization.py). Raw R1 wavelengths, reference wavelengths and individual measurement corrections are not recoverable; this is not raw-wavelength re-reduction. Row-wise pressure/volume uncertainties and covariance are unavailable, so full uncertainty propagation and exact weighted-fit parity are not established.

methods.source_location: Walker (2002), page 806, Experimental method: NaCl BE2 thermal form of Birch (1986)
methods.notes: BE2 is the quadratic reduced-strain form, not BM2. Birch (1986) Table 6 final extended 25 Celsius row verifies K0=23.88 GPa, a=1.796, b=-5.00; Equation 8 supplies the thermal term.

recalculation.notes: Walker page 806 identifies Birch (1986) NaCl-B1 BE2. The supplied original Birch PDF verifies the adjusted reference-isotherm BE2 coefficients (Table 6: K0=23.88 GPa, a=1.796, b=-5.00) and Equation 8 thermal term 0.00286*(T-298.15) GPa. A conditional B2 replay using separate printed run anchors is bundled in the audit, but the exact volume/reference normalization, unrounded inputs and uncertainty propagation remain unverified. No executable catalog scale link or ready dataset reduction is registered. See docs/literature-reproductions/walker-2002-kcl.md.

pressure_calibration.notes: Primary-source ancestry and Birch coefficients are verified. B1 ambient/36 Celsius anchor handling and exact author reduction remain unverified.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.
qualifications: Fixed Figure 1 V0=37.50 cm3/mol=249.0808601 conventional-cell A3 (Z=4); Tables 1/3 retain the conflicting 249.53 A3, K0 prime=5, Tr=296.15 K. Complete unweighted joint pressure fit per Walker page 808; exact author Solver inputs and constraints are unavailable. K0 rounds to 17.7 GPa; alpha_KT differs by 1.17%, within its printed error width; strict coefficient/uncertainty parity is not established. Individual elastic errors and covariance are not published. The printed BE1 signs are inconsistent with its positive strain definition; the compression-positive BM3 convention used by the existing B2 audit is retained explicitly.

fit.selection: 23 measured Table 1 KCl states; exclude six NaCl-only checks and one derived V0 anchor

scientific_validation.note: Figure 1 B1 reference V0=37.50 cm^3/mol is explicitly selected, giving 249.080860076 A^3 per Z=4 conventional cell. Tables 1/3 instead print 249.53 A^3 (37.57 cm^3/mol); their raw data and derived anchor are retained unchanged. The extra conversion digits are not measurement precision. Table 3 elastic/thermal coefficients: K0=177 kbar=17.7 GPa, K0 prime fixed at 5. The thermal coefficient is the directly reported alpha0*K0=0.0195(5) kbar/K=0.00195(5) GPa/K, rather than the rounded product 177*0.00011. T0=23 degC=296.15 K. Table 1 retains all 30 entries: 23 measured sample states, six separate NaCl spot checks without KCl volumes, and one derived 23 degC ambient-volume anchor. No individual elastic errors or covariance are assigned. The Table 1 volume heading erroneously says B2-KCl; volumes and Z=4 identify the B1 sample. Complete unweighted joint refit is close but not exact; see the dedicated reproduction. The marginal P-T bounds do not define a rectangular B1 stability region.
